userStories.title: Product Model & Technical Specs Admin API
userStories.description: Extend Product model with container load and technical documents, and implement comprehensive admin product management endpoints with RBAC and audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: Product model includes containerLoad and documents fields with idempotent PostgreSQL migration
GET /api/v1/admin/products returns paginated products with search, category, status (active/draft), and featured filters
GET /api/v1/admin/products/:id returns full commodity dossier including technical specs and verifiedFields
POST /api/v1/admin/products creates a new product with full specifications, trade parameters, and audit logging
PUT /api/v1/admin/products/:id updates product details, specs, and trade parameters with audit logging
PATCH /api/v1/admin/products/:id/toggle-active toggles active/draft state with audit logging
PATCH /api/v1/admin/products/:id/toggle-featured toggles featured status with audit logging
PATCH /api/v1/admin/products/:id/verify-spec toggles per-spec verification flag and updates verifiedFields
POST /api/v1/admin/products/:id/documents attaches TDS/SDS/COA documents with title, type, and url
RBAC strictly enforces that only admin and editor roles can modify products while sales/viewer have read access

userStories.title: Products & Technical Specs Desk UI with 5-Tab AdminDrawer
userStories.description: Build complete Products & Technical Specs Desk page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with spec table editor, trade parameters, document uploads, and live public preview
acceptanceCriteria: Products page renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Table displays Commodity Name with thumbnail, HS Code, Category & Division, MOQ, Shelf Life & Lead Time, Published Status, and Actions
FilterBar provides category filtering, search input, and status pills (All, Published, Draft, Featured)

Detail drawer features 5 focused tabs: 1) Basic Info & HS Classification, 2) Laboratory Spec Table Editor (with per-spec verified toggle), 3) Export Trade & Container Logistics (MOQ, Incoterms, Ports, FCL/LCL), 4) Technical Documents & Images (TDS/SDS/COA), 5) SEO & Publishing
Spec Table Editor allows adding, editing, deleting specification rows (parameter, test method, specification, typical value, verified flag)
Live public page preview link (/products/:slug) allows instant verification of public commodity view

userStories.title: Automated Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify product administration features with integration tests and ensure zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminProducts, fetchAdminProductById, toggleAdminProductActive, toggleAdminProductFeatured, and verifyProductSpec
Automated integration tests in server/tests/product-admin.test.js cover product CRUD, spec verification, document attachments, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
